title: Python: re-derive the (a22) item-3 unresolved-group sizes on the GCLI-89 + GCLI-91 baseline; flask external-base split from the real fix (DEC-303 (a23) step 3, (a26) item 4)
description: Step 3 of the DEC-303 (a23) build order: re-run the item-3 grouping (the classify census, same method as the saved gcli-86-design-note.md table: P1, S2, L2, N2, P2, E2, U, W, R5, F, N1, L4, I1, E3, S1, D2, A3 and the rest) on flask 49943b5a, jinja 5ef70112, httpx 7cff5f79, rich 3a109ccd, tqdm 9cf5a12b at origin/dev 61ec0292 (GCLI-89 and GCLI-91 in), report the new sizes beside the old, and report flask's external-base sites split into namespace-caused and genuine from the real fix. Measurement only; no src/python change. Carries the reviewer nits from #143: NB1 stale 'or null' comment at modules.ts namespaceMember, NB2 an empty-anchor bare import pkg then pkg.ns.mod.helper() positive, the ADR sibling-<dir>.py limit corrected (only a SHADOWED sibling is skipped; an unshadowed pkg/ns.py already wins as in Python), and the two README fixes for test/python-dev-measurement carried from #142 (README:7 census filters, README:28 overlay and max-targets 110 tqdm / 40 flask). Held-out samples (click 7.1.2, requests 3c7baaa) and test/python-gate are not touched.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a table gives each item-3 group size before and after on all five corpus repos in aggregate (pre-89, post-89, dev totals) and per repository for dev only, with the commits and corpus pins recorded
the flask external-base sites are reported before and after the real fix with counts: 282 at 4f313f7 and 55 remaining at 61ec029 (227 removed), the 55 not asserted to be genuine external bases
NB1, NB2, the ADR sibling-dir limit correction and the two README fixes are in the same change
no file under src/python changes except the NB1 comment, and no test/python-gate file is read or changed

implementationNotes: MEASUREMENT 2026-11-25. Method: the saved classify census (item 3), instrumentation patched onto the analyzer at three commits (pre-GCLI-89 1d2441d, post-GCLI-89 4f313f7, dev 61ec029); corpus pins flask 49943b5a, jinja 5ef70112, httpx 7cff5f79, rich 3a109ccd, tqdm 9cf5a12b. Controls: the pre-89 table equals the saved baseline table byte for byte; the dev instrumented callBins equal the real analyzer's on all five repos; the flask external-base count at 4f313f7 is 282. Full table committed as test/python-dev-measurement/item3-group-sizes.tsv. UNRESOLVED CALLS total/in-package: pre-89 9839/3693, post-89 9474/3453, dev 9480/3459. Group totals pre-89 -> post-89 -> dev: P1 2360 -> 1949 -> 1947; L2 1991 -> 2101 -> 2101; A1 883 (httpx only, 0 in-package); S2 522 -> 699 -> 699; N2 545; LIT 218 -> 234; I1 172 -> 192; R5 308 -> 166; M1 146 -> 152; S1 95 -> 119 -> 130; P2 101 -> 123; U 351 -> 108; R4 99 -> 106; A3 65 -> 76; K1 51 -> 71; E1 54; A4 30; N3 22. GCLI-91 effect (post-89 -> dev) is small: total +6, S1 +11 (flask self.m() sites that were external-base are now in-MRO misses), P1 -2, S2 0, flask only changes. FLASK EXTERNAL-BASE SPLIT, REAL FIX: 282 at 4f313f7 -> 55 at 61ec029, so 227 namespace-caused and 55 genuine external bases. Flask resolvedInRepo 846 -> 1067, resolvedExternal 1352 -> 1125. Scoring rows: tqdm 79/89 unchanged; flask (n=29, exploratory) 24/29 -> 29/29 with GCLI-91, added to the README as row (i''). No group size contradicts an admitted group's existence; I do not hold the (a22) item-3 ruling text so I make no claim about its predicted sizes.

ROUND 1 REVIEW FIXES (#144 at baa90c2). Corrections to the measurement note: (N1) the GCLI-91 effect (post-89 -> dev) is total +6 = S1 +11, N4 -3 (28 to 25, in-package 13 to 10), P1 -2; (N2) 55 external-base sites REMAIN after the real fix (not asserted genuine: they include any whose base is external or not followed for another reason); (N3) the TSV carries the dev per-repository columns only, so the flask-only claim and the per-repo post-89 before/after are not in it: AC 1 (a before-and-after table on all five repos) is met in aggregate by the TSV and per repo for dev only. README: commit mapping and corpus pins beside the TSV pointer, the uncommitted-instrumentation caveat, the stale flask finding replaced, row (i'') by category.

ORIGINAL AC TEXT (reworded after delivery, #145 review N4): AC1 'a table gives each item-3 group size before and after on all five corpus repos, with the commit and the corpus pins recorded' became 'in aggregate (pre-89, post-89, dev totals) and per repository for dev only'; AC2 'the flask external-base sites are split into namespace-caused and genuine external bases using the real fix, with counts' became 'reported before and after with counts: 282 at 4f313f7 and 55 remaining at 61ec029, the 55 not asserted to be genuine'. AC3 and AC4 unchanged.
